answer: For a poll on protecting saffron fields from an ember crossing a firebreak vertex, the server checks each ballot’s fresh challenge and nonce. After n accepted ballots, it requires 20+floor(n/100) leading zero bits in their hash; it rejects failures or reused challenges. Assuming uniform hashes, the first ballot takes about 2^20 trials on average. Later voters face higher costs, and fast hardware has an advantage.
